build_imagenet_22k_json: run the script to build an ImageNet-22k image info JSON from tar files and WordNet categories
extract_imagenet_categories: extract ImageNet category metadata including synsets, synonyms, and definitions using NLTK WordNet
create_disktar_dataset: create a DiskTarDataset from tar file paths and index directories for ImageNet-21k data
iterate_imagenet_images: iterate through ImageNet images using a PyTorch DataLoader with multi-worker support
save_imagenet_annotations: save ImageNet image info and category data as a JSON annotation file
